race.comment: LA REINA VEGA (7) has just found one better in both starts, backed into $1.35 last time at Pakenham Synthetic when just nosed out. Better for that again and we get a much better price this time for the top yard. Can atone. KEEN OBSERVER (5) is in the same boat with two narrow defeats to date, good on similar ground at Geelong last time when beaten under half a length. Shinn sticks from the inside gate, he'll be very hard to run down. They look the clear two chances and the others would need them to underperform significantly but TOMMY'S LASS (9) is coming along well and was good here last time. AUTUMN IN GRINZING (6) could be an improver this time in.
